notes.title: Quick update - Fury mode
notes.notes:
Quick update to Fury mode activity levels, wanted to adjust it differently. In this update, I've adjusted the activity level to start off pretty strong but won't reach maximum activity until the last SET is activated. The goal here is to make the beginning more active, but also making sure maximum activity isn't initiated until the last SET is turned on.

The difficulty of Fury mode will be about the same, in short, toning down the activity levels for SET activations 3 and 4, while also toning up the activity levels for SET activations 1 and 2.

notes.title: quick update - build mode patch
notes.notes: Quick update to get out a build mode patch. Previously, there was an issue uploading screenshots, preventing uploads. But now, what should happen is if the screenshot is too big, the upload will default to a basic screenshot for uploading. In which case, you can adjust the screenshot in the workshop outside of the game if necessary.

notes.title: Build Mode Update - New Items, Dome Size, and more!
notes.notes:
Build mode now has a new section for construction items, as well as new dome sizes to choose from in the terrain editor! There is also a fix to the screenshot issue, which will hopefully fix the uploading issue as the screenshot file size was to big. You'll notice in the new update that there are black borders around the screenshot, this is to reduce the file size of the screenshot all-together. With how the screen capture is setup, there wasn't much alternative, but should still suffice for now.

[b]Additions:[/b]

[i]- Construction Items
- Dome size options in terrain editor[/i]

[b]Fixes:[/b]

[i]- Screenshot has now been adjusted to capture a smaller resolution, should fix the majority of uploading issues[/i]

notes.title: Quick update, build mode additions and fixes
notes.notes: Added a few new models to the game, as well as fixed a few mesh collisions of the buildings. There was also an issue with uploading, there should be a new system that shows what the error is if it fails. I also discovered an issue with the file size for screenshots, so if you had issues uploading, it likely was due to the screenshot file being to big. This patch comes with a fix, making the screenshots lower resolution therefore lower in size, so that error in question should be fixed. However, this does mean if you already have levels saved, you will have to re-save the level to get the appropriate screenshot size for uploading. Hopefully, this patch will resolve most of the issues with uploading to Steam Workshop, feel free to reach out if there are more.

notes.title: Quick patch - build mode
notes.notes: Quick patch, some naming conventions were misnamed, that has been changed. Also had an issue where car bodies would not appear, that issue should be resolved as well

notes.title: Build Mode update / New Behavior
notes.notes:
Build mode has gotten another update, adding in a new behavior called 'Crawler'. Crawlers have the same behavior as Seekers, but Crawlers will spawn at a speed of 20 mph, not making noise until it spots you. Anomalies throughout the main story have also been added! Most anomalies outside the 9 can be used if they have been discovered in the main story line.

Additions to Build Mode:

- New anomalies (all main story anomalies, excluding 4 in specific)
- New Behavior, 'Crawler'
- New models, (skyscrapers, buildings, containers)

Fixes to Build Mode:

- Issue where car minimap icon was visible in game and not in the radar has now been fixed.
- Some objects prior to this update weren't able to be deleted properly, that has now been patched.

notes.title: Build Mode Update / Steam Workshop
notes.notes:
This build mode updates comes with quite a few things. Most notably, Steam Workshop has been added to the game! You can now upload custom created levels through build mode for others to play! Still early in development, but pretty sizable update!

Build Mode Additions:

- Steam Workshop
- Skyscraper models
- New terrain options
- New anomalies (DT3 basics)
- Ramps

Build Mode Patches:

- Certain vehicles did not function, that has been fixed.
- Soundtrack would glitch out with multiple anomalies chasing you, should not do so anymore.

notes.title: AC1 Finale Update!
notes.notes:
AC1 has been added to the story, concluding the story! This comes with a new map, 3 unlockable cars (one more in tower, one as a key collectable in the new map, and one for completing AC1), as well as a couple adjustments to exhibition, the first 3 bosses have been added to exhibition if you have beaten those bosses in said areas. 

While this is the end of the story of Junkyard Fury 2, this doesn't necessarily mean that this will be the last update. I will eventually come back to this title every once and a while to add a few more pieces of content, so I do intend to continue updating here and there while working on my other title.

This has been quite a journey, and glad a lot of you enjoyed this title along with the series! Thank you for all the support!

notes.title: Quick patch - Bully buff, Credits updated
notes.notes: Quick patch, Bully boss has been toned down a bit with the frost missile, and the options menu now holds the credits roll. Credits throughout the game have been updated as well with the music that has been implemented within the DLC if you choose to check it out.

notes.title: Quick patch - vehicle adjustments (DLC), save system change
notes.notes: Quick patch, adjusted the save system, nothing noticeable aside from the notification of when the game saves during scene transition, and adjusted the newer vehicles, namely 'Ice Cream Truck' and 'R32' with their handling. Ice Cream Truck is more stable now, should feel better. R32 has been worked on, handling is a little bit better, but not the best, may adjust it again in the future.

notes.title: Quick patch - walls added to DT3 (Destroyed) level in DLC
notes.notes: Quick patch, walls had been glitched where they wouldn't appear in DT3 (Destroyed) level, should be resolved now.

notes.title: Big DLC Update!
notes.notes:
Big update for the JF2 DLC! Added a workshop for you to customize and upgrade your SVCs! As well as adding in a new mode called 'Tower Mode' where you'll work your way up to the top to earn workshop resources! In addition to all this, there is also a new powerup called Burst, which is a burst beam that shoots in front and makes enemies fly up a bit while taking a little bit of damage! 

Also fixed the load time issues. I did have to increase the file size of the DLC, making it around 3gb, but the files should load in much faster now.

notes.title: Annihilation Update! UA2 Addition
notes.notes: New map has been added to the game, UA2! Along with new challenges in the ladder mode! Also added a few more soundtracks.

notes.title: Annihilation Update! DT4 Addition
notes.notes: Update for the JF2 DLC! Added a new challenge section for a new map, DT4! map is also accessible through exhibition too! Also adjusted some vehicles, most notably 'Beast', improving handling. Will keep you posted!

notes.title: v1.047 - Quick patch
notes.notes: Adjusted some issues in AA1, mostly affecting doors that didn't have collision. Alos adjusted the difficulty to where pathfinding for killer cars will be easier if played on the low difficulty, and pathfinding for killer cars will be harder on high difficulty.

notes.title: v1.045 - Quick patch
notes.notes: Added a patch that fixes the normal ending issue, should now get the normal ending regardless of perfection. Also adjusted the difficulty on the secret level as it was a bit aggressive.

notes.title: v1.0432 - quick patch
notes.notes: Quick patch, there were some collider issues in the last level where you would go through light objects, should be good now

notes.title: v1.043 - AA1 patch, Third-person view
notes.notes: There was an issue I just discovered in which AA1 couldn't be perfected properly. That issue has now been fixed, sorry if you have experienced issues with this. Also, quite a few people have asked for a third person view when driving, and it is now accessible in the game! There are new instructions inside the Training level that show how to do so.

notes.title: v1.041 - quick patch
notes.notes: Issue with vehicles not being fixable has been patched, vehicles that are were unfixable are now fixable.

notes.title: Mirror Functionality Update - v1.036
notes.notes: Added functionality for Mirrors, can now look through specific mirrors depending on vehicles to see what is behind you while driving.

notes.title: v1.033 - Quick Patch
notes.notes: Quick patch, just added a controls section that showcases the PS4 gamepad inputs. Other minor changes to optimization as well.

notes.title: v1.032 - Quick Patch
notes.notes: Quick patch for JF2, added some changes to the GUI for upgrades, and also added a new health mechanic within the upgrades that you can get.

notes.title: v1.031 - Quick Patch
notes.notes: IA4 has been updated with more trailers to search from as some areas were pretty empty.

notes.title: v1.03 - Quick patch, fixed glitch in testing area
notes.notes: Quick patch, added a couple things to levels, minor changes. Training area had a glitch where the car sometimes wouldn't start after repairing it, should work as intended now.

notes.title: Quick Patch - v1.02
notes.notes: Quick patch, small adjustments have been made. Worked on the hit registration, lowered the sensitivity to avoid situations where you run into your own car and die (Not by a lot, mainly in situations where you exit a vehicle at lower than 5 mph and end up touching the vehicle). Also updated DT3, updating spawn chances and positions, should have a better spawn rate.

notes.title: Quick patch - v1.01
notes.notes: A few minor changes, some material edits, added a menu button in the prep rooms for better navigation. Also raised the cost of upgrades, considering how easy it is to gain research. Changes are mostly focused on high range upgrades.
